claims.claim: Convert CGPA using scheme-labelled official formulas or a custom formula, without implying that one conversion applies to every university.
Only the named scheme/version formulas shown are claimed. Users must verify their exact programme/regulation before using an equivalence.
VIT and Anna University cited formulas are CGPA × 10 for the cited documents; VTU 2015/2017/2018 cited formula is (CGPA − 0.75) × 10.
